researchLog.note: Round 4 searched without result: FamilySearch: Alice Comerford (L85M-PP2) has no parents attached; No online record linking Alice to Castlecomer
Round 4: flagged that a c.1821 birth is too late for the father of Alice (b. c.1835).

conflicts.found: His supposed daughter Alice Comerford was 35 in the 1870 census (b. c.1835)
conflicts.assessment: A father born c.1821 would have been about 14 at Alice's birth. The tree's Thomas Comerford (d. Castlecomer, Co. Kilkenny, 1878) and wife Mary Dowling (b. 1815) have no sources; at best this is a guessed family. Castlecomer is a plausible Comerford district, but nothing links Alice to it.

sources: [R4-S1] 1870 U.S. census, Plymouth Township, Luzerne Co., Pa., p.66, enumerated 29 Jul 1870 by Roberson Boyd, P.O.
